description: Flynn Carsen and Guardian Eve Baird recruit three unconventional new Librarians as the Serpent Brotherhood tries to restore uncontrolled magic to the world, forcing the inexperienced team to learn how to survive artifacts, legends and one another.

s01e01.description: Flynn Carsen and new Guardian Eve Baird race to protect three surviving Librarian candidates after someone begins murdering the others, leading them to the Serpent Brotherhood and King Arthur's crown.

s01e02.description: With the Library sealed away and Flynn gravely wounded, the new team pursues the Serpent Brotherhood to a ritual intended to return uncontrolled magic to the world.

s01e03.description: The new Librarians tackle their first mission without Flynn and discover missing interns are trapped in a modern corporate labyrinth built around an imprisoned Minotaur.

s01e04.description: Santa is attacked while carrying out a hidden magical duty, forcing the Librarians to protect him and keep the deeper purpose of Christmas from collapsing.

s01e05.description: Flynn returns when dragons threaten to wake beneath the world, sending the team after a treasure tied to the Apple of Discord and an old supernatural bargain.

s01e06.description: In a town where fairy-tale stories are becoming physically real, the Librarians must identify the artifact rewriting ordinary people into dangerous characters before the story reaches its ending.

s01e07.description: Competitive students at a prestigious school begin using real witchcraft against one another, leaving the Librarians to stop escalating spells before academic rivalry becomes lethal.

s01e08.description: A supposed haunted house traps the team inside a supernatural structure that feeds on fear, forcing them to uncover the truth behind the legend before it claims another victim.

s01e09.description: A missing-person case in a rural town appears to reveal an alien invasion, but the Librarians discover a hidden community and a light-based phenomenon with a different explanation.

s01e10.description: Dulaque uses the Loom of Fate to rewrite history, sending Baird through alternate lives in which the Librarians followed radically different paths and the world paid the price.
